review_plan.claim_under_review: Producer claim (repair-report.yaml / TASK-20260912-f821b2, as later documented by TASK-20260912-c08c1b): the four DEC-20260908-ffb734 REVISE findings C6, C9, C11, C12 are closed in source; C8 is a documentation-only resolution that scalar_multiply leaves normalization to the caller; no scientific job was run.
review_plan.coordinator_prior: Written before any reviewer of this round runs. Expected finding: C6/C11/C12 are closed on current main (the concurrent repair plus c08c1b docstring alignment). C9 is closed if point_add_planted, point_double_planted, and scalar_multiply_planted exist and route every top-level M through planted_mul. C8 is closed only as a documented caller-responsibility contract, not as a behavior change. Residual risk: a textual match that still uses the wrong Y3 operand under an alias, or an insert_if_absent probe that compares hashes but not stored (x,y). This prior is not a verdict.

joints.joint: C6 generic ADD Y3 equals spec common_z_formula Y3=M(j,B-X3)-M(V1,C-B)
joints.attack_plan: From specification.arithmetic.addition.common_z_formula only, write the two Y3 multiplicands. Then read arithmetic.py point_add (and point_add_planted if present) and show whether the first product's second operand is B-X3 or still C-B / an alias of C-B. Do not execute point_add.
joints.breaking_artifact: A cited source line whose first Y3 product uses C-B, B-C, or any operand other than B-X3.

joints.attack_plan: Read the scalar_multiply docstring and return. Confirm it returns the raw Jacobian point and that normalize() is a separate charged 3M+1S+1I caller step, matching the frozen scalar_algorithm plus normalization fields. Flag any call site in driver/rho that treats the raw return as affine.
joints.breaking_artifact: A call site that consumes scalar_multiply output as affine without normalize(), or a docstring that still claims in-routine normalization.

joints.attack_plan: Confirm point_add_planted, point_double_planted, and scalar_multiply_planted exist and that every top-level M in those routines goes through planted_mul, with S and I unchanged. Count M call sites; a leftover FieldElement.mul on a planted path reopens C9.
joints.breaking_artifact: A missing planted routine, or a planted-path M that is not planted_mul.

joints.attack_plan: Trace the probe loop. On an occupied slot, the occupant (x,y) must be compared to the candidate (x,y); match returns (False, occupant) immediately; mismatch continues probing. The old post-loop `if idx in self.slots` dead branch must be gone. Do not run a rho job.
joints.breaking_artifact: A probe loop that only exits on an empty slot, or a comparison that uses only the table hash and not stored (x,y).

joints.joint: C12 cgroup cpu.max by job type and exact pids.max==3
joints.attack_plan: Read check_cgroup_admission. Confirm cpu.max required strings 100000 100000 (arithmetic) and 300000 100000 (rho), and that pids.max must equal 3 exactly (not `None or > 3`). Note the job_type alias behavior as actually coded.
joints.breaking_artifact: A missing cpu.max check, a wrong required string, or a pids.max predicate that accepts 1, 2, or None.

objects: Pre-repair Y3 using C-B for both products (the exact C6 defect in TASK-20260908-30ce59). Any argument that this old formula "matches common_z_formula" is known-false.
Pre-repair insert_if_absent whose while-loop only exits on an empty slot. Any argument that this old function "detects repeated endpoints" is known-false.
proves_too_much.failure_signature: The reviewer's matching argument must fail on each known-false object. If the same argument still certifies the old code, the review has proved too much.

blind_rederivation.quantity: Generic common-Z addition Y3 after X3 is known, from the frozen specification token string Y3=M(j,B-X3)-M(V1,C-B) only.
blind_rederivation.parameters: Spec tokens U1,U2,V1,V2,Z,h,j,A,B,C,D,X3 as defined in specification.arithmetic.addition; no producer identifiers.
